# Graph-Level Metrics & Community Detection Comparison

**Sumber data:** v4_hybrid (`nodes_v4_hybrid.csv` + `edges_v4_hybrid.csv`) — NER S4-augmentation
**Generated by:** `sna_graph_metrics.py`

## 1. Graph-Level Metrics

| Metric | Value | Interpretasi |
|---|---:|---|
| n_nodes | 288 | Jumlah Person (node) di graf |
| n_edges | 1986 | Jumlah relasi (co-participation + Person-Person) |
| average_degree | 13.79 | Rata-rata koneksi per orang |
| density | 0.0481 | Rasio actual edges vs possible edges (0=sparse, 1=complete graph) |
| average_clustering_coefficient | 0.5639 | Rata-rata seberapa cluster tetangga tiap node (lokal) |
| transitivity_global | 0.7266 | Global clustering: rasio segitiga / triplet (kohesi keseluruhan) |
| degree_assortativity | -0.0808 | Positif = high-degree connect to high-degree; negatif = high connect to low (hub-and-spoke) |
| n_components | 9 | Jumlah connected components (kalau >1, graf tidak fully connected) |
| giant_component_size | 270 | Ukuran komponen terbesar |
| giant_component_ratio | 0.9375 | % node dalam giant component |
| giant_diameter | 6 | Diameter giant component (jarak terjauh dua node) |
| giant_radius | 3 | Radius giant component |
| giant_avg_shortest_path | 2.90 | Rata-rata path length di giant component |

## 2. Community Detection Comparison

Bandingkan **3 metode community detection**:
- **Louvain (proper)** — `nx.community.louvain_communities()` (NetworkX 2.7+).
- **Greedy Modularity** — `nx.community.greedy_modularity_communities()` (yang dipakai `sna_analysis.py` existing, secara teknis BUKAN Louvain meskipun di kode lama dilabeli 'Louvain').
- **Girvan-Newman** — iterative edge removal, capped di 16 partisi.

### 2.1 Modularity & Jumlah Komunitas

| Method | n_communities | Modularity Q | Catatan |
|---|---:|---:|---|
| louvain | 17 | 0.4429 | Standar emas balanced quality+speed |
| greedy | 21 | 0.4266 | Faster tapi quality lebih rendah; legacy di `sna_analysis.py` |
| girvan_newman | 16 | 0.2098 | Slow tapi interpretable (edge-betweenness based) |

### 2.2 Pairwise Adjusted Rand Index (ARI)

ARI mengukur **kesepakatan** antara 2 partisi (0=random, 1=identical).
ARI tinggi → metode-metode menemukan struktur komunitas yang serupa.

| Method | louvain | greedy | girvan_newman |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| louvain | 1.0000 | 0.6946 | 0.3457 |
| greedy | 0.6946 | 1.0000 | 0.5025 |
| girvan_newman | 0.3457 | 0.5025 | 1.0000 |

## 3. Klaim yang Bisa Dipertahankan (untuk Bab 4)

- Knowledge Graph Sirah ini punya **288 Person** dengan **1986 relasi** (density 0.0481).
- Struktur komunitas terdeteksi: **17 kelompok** (modularity 0.4429) — menunjukkan adanya **faksi/kelompok diskursus** yang berbeda.
- Clustering coefficient 0.5639 (lokal) vs 0.7266 (global) — interpretasi: banyak tetangga node yang juga saling terhubung (kohesi lokal tinggi).
- Degree assortativity -0.0808: mendekati neutral.

- ARI antara Louvain & Greedy: 0.6946 (agreement moderat — metode menghasilkan struktur yang berbeda, perlu pertimbangan saat klaim komunitas).
